notes:
Background: Citadel Spectral Intelligence is a defense-focused analytics org supporting federated intelligence teams. Heavy emphasis on assured search across classified datasets. Procurement-heavy org (multiple contracting layers).

Primary requirements (summary):
- RAG/Enterprise search for classified docs (multi-format: PDF, PST, tape archives).
- Indexing scale target: initial POC 20M docs (~9TB raw), roadmap to 200M+ documents across domains.
- Embeddings: prefer open/quantized models (Llama family / open alternatives) to avoid export controls; vectors stored in on-prem vector store. 1536-4096 dims considered.
- Reranking: two-stage architecture (ANN retrieval + reranker neural model). Target rerank latency end-to-end: 150-250ms P95; soft requirement P99 < 400ms for investigative workflows.
- Throughput: expected concurrency 100-500 qps during peak; background batch reindex windows acceptable.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement wants cost-per-query baseline for 3-year reserved capacity; target effective cost < $0.10/query for standard queries, lower for cached/templated flows.
- Security: must run in air-gapped enclaves or FIPS HSM-backed KMS; full audit logging, SSO/SAML + RBAC, data residency and retention controls. FedRAMP-equivalent expectations for JAB review.
- Model management: ability to pin model versions, staged rollouts (canary/A-B), and automatic fallback to quantized variants when capacity constrained.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (AE + SE) — high-level requirements capture (fireflies ff-2026-01-12-4589).
- 2026-02-18: Security deep-dive with CISO team; Redwood security deck shared, asked for HSM/KMS specifics (ff-2026-02-18-7712).
- 2026-03-02: Architecture workshop with infra + ops — discussed on-prem deployment model, VLAN segmentation, and ingest throughput (ff-2026-03-02-7841).
- 2026-03-08: Pricing sync — procurement requested 3-year reserved pricing and SOW template; legal requested export-control clause draft.

POC plan (proposed):
- Phase 0: Air-gapped network prep + baseline measurements (2 weeks).
- Phase 1: Ingest 20M documents, run embedding pipeline (batch offload to dedicated GPU node), build vector index, initial ANN retrieval tests (4 weeks).
- Phase 2: Integrate neural reranker, run evaluation suite (MRR, recall@10, latency P95/P99), user acceptance with analyst team (3 weeks).
- Phase 3: Ops hardening: autoscaling policy, KV/prefix caching, rollout plan + SLA targets (2 weeks).
Acceptance metrics: recall@10 > 0.85 on labeled test sets, MRR improvement +12% vs baseline BM25, P95 latency < 250ms for single-query rerank path.

Procurement notes & blockers: 
- Must provide air-gapped demo option on Redwood Private (on-prem appliance) plus written security addendum.
- Legal requires export control and data handling language; procurement asks for indemnity carveouts for classified data.
- Budget committee wants cost-per-query modeled for three workload tiers (investigative, analyst, background).
- CISO: "We need FIPS HSM KMS and full chain-of-custody audit for every inference event" — working with security to map controls.

Competitive landscape observed by customer: Palantir (baseline integration), Elastic (indexing), Pinecone/Milvus for vector store. Customer values end-to-end observability and RL/ops for production inference.

Open asks for Redwood:
- Provide detailed bill-of-materials and three-year reserved pricing for on-prem/dedicated (including support tiers).
- Provide air-gapped deployment checklist and timeline for physical onsite install.
- Confirm supported quantized model variants and recommended embedding dims/cost tradeoffs.
- Provide sample SOW and security addendum tailored for classified environments.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to deliver air-gapped pricing + security addendum (owner: Maya Chen) by 2026-03-20.
- SE to prepare POC runbook and required HW spec for ingest (owner: Liam O'Connor).
- Schedule on-site kickoff for enclave setup once pricing approved.
